title: Server ignores SIGTERM while an EventSource client is connected
description: clean-room client: mimid ignored SIGTERM with an EventSource client connected; SIGINT worked. Graceful shutdown must close push streams.
close_reason: Fixed in 12669fa (branch cleanroom-bugs): shutdown bounded by a 10 s grace; a stuck in-flight request held the process after SIGTERM/SIGINT. EventSource/live streams already ended at once.
